title: Microwave measurements of d-f-g-h intervals and d and f fine structure of sodium Rydberg states
method: microwave resonance (single-, two-, three-photon) with selective field ionization, stray field reduced to ~8 mV/cm, residual Stark shifts corrected by series fits
caveats: Intervals relative to nd levels; absolute f, g, h energies need nd energies (e.g. from Dyubko 1995 / Ciocca 1992 quantum defects).
Fine-structure rows are differences of measured lines; do not use them together with the underlying lines as independent data.
